topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The news hits hard, a sudden, silent blow. My favorite place, where the walls seemed to echo laughter and the scent of dishes always brought a smile, it’s closing. They say the building needs repairs, costs too high, but the real breakdown is here, in the space where once I found comfort. Each memory weighs more now, the cups of coffee richer, the late-night meals more satisfying, because they are finite. The world outside will keep spinning, people will find new spots to gather, but this one, this corner of the world that felt tailor-made, will just...vanish. There’s a gnawing urge to go back, one last time, to taste the farewell in every bite, hoping it will bring some semblance of closure. But even that feels like a fleeting dream, slipping through my fingers just like the sands of a timeless hourglass.
